title: Integration
description:
SPEC-INSTANCES-01: one connected service instance, such as a Home Assistant server or an Uptime Kuma monitor. One record per instance, not one per type, so a household can connect two Uptime Kuma monitors. Design: Home docs/design/connector-instances-2026-11-06.md.

UNIQUENESS: the pair (type, instance) is unique across all records, tombstoned ones included, so a slug is never reused for the same type. Schemas cannot express this; validateIntegrations in records/ts/validate.ts checks it. At most 8 live instances per type is a hub rule, not a schema rule.

REMOVAL: removing an instance sets deleted_at (a tombstone). The record is kept so the slug stays taken.

GRANT TARGETS: a grant target for an integration action may be `<instance>/<native target>`, split at the first `/` (the slug never contains `/` or `:`, and a native target may, as Gitea's `owner/repo` does). A target without an instance prefix means the `default` instance. The `by_parameter` device class is passed separately and is never parsed out of the target.

SECRETS: this record never holds a secret. `credential_ref` is an opaque reference into the credentials center.

type.description: Which kind of service this is.

instance.description: Short slug, unique within the type, chosen once and never reused. Never contains `/` or `:`. The first instance of a type is `default`.

label.description: What people call this instance, for example "Cabin".

address.description: The URL an admin set for this instance.

credential_ref.description: Opaque reference into the credentials center. It names where the secret is kept and is never the secret itself.

enabled.description: False keeps the instance configured but unused.

options.description: Non-secret per-instance settings a connector needs, for example Uptime Kuma's `status_page` slug. Keys are short lowercase names; values are strings of at most 200 characters; at most 8 keys. Never a credential: the key names token, password, secret and api_key are rejected, and secrets stay in the credentials center behind `credential_ref`. Absent when there are none.

deleted_at.description: Tombstone. Set when an admin removes the instance; null while it exists. The record is kept so the slug is never reused.

provenance.description: How this record came to exist, for example "admin" or "migrated:home.base_url".
